items.title: Two Late Scores Give UW 17-10 Win At Nebraska
items.summary: LINCOLN, Neb. (AP) — Chris Lawson scored the go-ahead touchdown on a 25-yard catch-and-run with 1:30 left and Alex McLaughlin returned Anthony Colandrea's third interception of the game 48 yards for the clinching score as Washington came from behind to beat Nebraska 17-10 on Saturday night.

items.title: Huskies & Huskers To Meet In Lincoln On Halloween Night
items.summary: After a week off that followed a 38-26, Friday night road win at Purdue, the Washington football team (4-3, 1-3 Big Ten) returns to action this Saturday night, when the Huskies head to Lincoln, Neb., to face Nebraska (5-2, 2-2) on Halloween. The game will kick off at 7:00 p.m. CT / 5:00 p.m. PT and will air on the Big Ten Network.
